-- 火车大劫案
function initTrain()
    if not GameHelper.Switch.Train then return end

    -- print("初始化火车大劫案，沼泽中心点",centerGrid1X,centerGrid1Z)
    local offset = MapHelper.gridSize_2 * 2 + math.floor(MapHelper.gridSize_2 / 2) -- 应该是10
    local pointConfigs = {
        {
            x = MapHelper.centerGrid1 - offset,
        },
        {
            x = MapHelper.centerGrid1 + offset,
        },
        {
            z = MapHelper.centerGrid1 - offset,
        },
        {
            z = MapHelper.centerGrid1 + offset,
        },
    }

    local suc = false
    while #pointConfigs > 0 do
        local pointConfig = table.remove(pointConfigs,math.random(1,#pointConfigs))
        local startGrid1X = pointConfig.x or 1
        local startGrid1Z = pointConfig.z or 1
        local endGrid1X = pointConfig.x or MapHelper.mapSize_1
        local endGrid1Z = pointConfig.z or MapHelper.mapSize_1

        -- 寻找一条合法的路
        local isMatch = true
        for grid1X = startGrid1X, endGrid1X do
            for grid1Z = startGrid1Z, endGrid1Z do
                local gridType = MapHelper:GetMapGridType(grid1X,grid1Z)
                if gridType then
                    isMatch = false
                    break
                end
            end
            if not isMatch then
                break
            end
        end
        if not isMatch then continue end

        local rotationOffset = 0
        if startGrid1X ~= endGrid1X then
            rotationOffset = 90
        end

        local startGround:Part = nil
        local endGround:Part = nil
        for grid1X = startGrid1X, endGrid1X do
            for grid1Z = startGrid1Z, endGrid1Z do
                local groundPrefabName = "铁轨路"
                if grid1X  == startGrid1X and grid1Z == startGrid1Z then
                    groundPrefabName = "铁轨出入口"
                elseif grid1X == endGrid1X and grid1Z == endGrid1Z then
                    groundPrefabName = "铁轨出入口"
                end

                local ground = createNormalLand(grid1X,grid1Z,0,groundPrefabName)
                local cframe = ground:GetPivot()
                ground:PivotTo(CFrame.Angles(0,math.rad(rotationOffset),0) + cframe.Position)
                ground:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.RailwayGround)
                MapHelper:SetMapGridType(grid1X,grid1Z,GridType.Railway)

                if grid1X  == startGrid1X and grid1Z == startGrid1Z then
                    startGround = ground
                elseif grid1X == endGrid1X and grid1Z == endGrid1Z then
                    endGround = ground
                end
            end
        end

        if math.random(1,2) == 1 then
            -- 换方向
            local markStartGround = startGround
            startGround = endGround
            endGround = markStartGround
        end

        startGround:PivotTo(CFrame.new(startGround:GetPivot().Position,endGround:GetPivot().Position))
        endGround:PivotTo(CFrame.new(endGround:GetPivot().Position,startGround:GetPivot().Position))

        startGround:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.RailwayGroundStart)
        endGround:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.RailwayGroundEnd)
        suc = true
        break
    end

    if not suc then
        local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild("火车大劫案")
        if folder then
            folder:Destroy()
        end
    end
end

function initKingMooseNest()
    if not GameHelper.Switch.KingMoose then return end

    local prefab = _specialHouse and _specialHouse:FindFirstChild("1x1,驼鹿巢穴")
    if not prefab then
        warn("[MapService] King Moose nest prefab is missing")
        return
    end

    local candidates = {}
    for zoneLv = 3,6 do
        local zoneGridPoints = MapHelper.ZoneMap1[zoneLv] or {}
        for _,gridPoint in ipairs(zoneGridPoints) do
            local grid1X = gridPoint.x
            local grid1Z = gridPoint.z
            if MapHelper:GetMapGridType(grid1X,grid1Z) ~= GridType.land then continue end
            if not MapHelper:FindGroundPart(grid1X,grid1Z) then continue end
            if not MapHelper:GetIsSafetyBuildingPoint(grid1X,grid1Z,1,1,GridType.land) then continue end
            table.insert(candidates,{
                x = grid1X,
                z = grid1Z,
                zoneLv = zoneLv,
            })
        end
    end

    for i = #candidates,2,-1 do
        local swapIndex = math.random(1,i)
        candidates[i],candidates[swapIndex] = candidates[swapIndex],candidates[i]
    end

    for _,candidate in ipairs(candidates) do
        if MapHelper:GetMapGridType(candidate.x,candidate.z) ~= GridType.land then continue end
        if not MapHelper:FindGroundPart(candidate.x,candidate.z) then continue end
        if not MapHelper:GetIsSafetyBuildingPoint(candidate.x,candidate.z,1,1,GridType.land) then continue end

        local grid2X,grid2Z = MapHelper:Grid1ToGrid2(candidate.x,candidate.z)
        local nest = MapHelper:CreateBuilding(
            candidate.x,
            candidate.z,
            1,
            1,
            GridType.building,
            prefab
        )
        if not nest then continue end

        initBuilding(nest,grid2X,grid2Z)
        nest:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.KingMooseNest)
        nest:SetAttribute("KingMooseNestZone",candidate.zoneLv)
        print("生成驼鹿巢穴",candidate.zoneLv,candidate.x,candidate.z)
        return
    end

    warn("[MapService] Could not place King Moose nest in zones 3-6")
end

local _mapMarkerFolder:Model = workspace:FindFirstChild("MapMarkers")

    _mapMarkerFolder.ModelStreamingMode = Enum.ModelStreamingMode.Persistent
    _mapMarkerFolder.Parent = workspace
end

local _mapMarkersByUserId = {}

local function getMarkerName(userId:number)
    return string.format("MapMarker_%d",userId)
end

local function canUseMapMarkers(player:Player)
    return GameHelper:isAlive(player) and #CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Map) > 0
end

local function getCampfireState()
    local heat = GameHelper:GetCampfireHeat()
    local level = GameHelper:GetCampfireLevel()
    return heat, level
end

local function destroyMarkerModel(userId:number)
    local markerModel = _mapMarkerFolder:FindFirstChild(getMarkerName(userId))
    if markerModel then
        markerModel:Destroy()
    end
end

local function buildMarkerVo(player:Player,position:Vector3)
    return {
        userId = player.UserId,
        nickname = player.DisplayName,
        position = position,
    }
end

local function createMarkerModel(markerVo)
    local prefab = workspace.Prefabs.Map:FindFirstChild("MapMarker")
    if not prefab then return end

    destroyMarkerModel(markerVo.userId)

    local markerModel:Model = prefab:Clone()
    markerModel.Name = getMarkerName(markerVo.userId)
    markerModel:PivotTo(CFrame.new(markerVo.position + Vector3.new(0,1.25,0)))
    markerModel.Parent = _mapMarkerFolder
    markerModel:SetAttribute("userId",markerVo.userId)
    markerModel:SetAttribute("nickname",markerVo.nickname)

    local root:BasePart = markerModel.PrimaryPart or markerModel:FindFirstChild("Root")
    if root then
        local billboard:BillboardGui = root:FindFirstChild("BillboardGui")
        if billboard then
            local t_name:TextLabel = billboard:FindFirstChild("t_name")
            if t_name then
                t_name.Text = markerVo.nickname
            end
        end
    end
end

local function isMarkerPositionUnlocked(position:Vector3,campfireLevel:number)
    local grid1X,grid1Z = MapHelper:Pos2Grid1(position)
    if not MapHelper:IsInMapGrid1(grid1X,grid1Z) then
        return false
    end
    return MapHelper:GetZoneLevelByGrid1(grid1X,grid1Z) <= campfireLevel
end

local function resolveMarkerWorldPosition(scale:Vector2)
    local worldPos = MapHelper:MapScaleToWorldPos(scale.X,scale.Y)
    local groundPoint = MapHelper:GetGroundPoint(Vector3.new(worldPos.X,10,worldPos.Z))
    if groundPoint then
        return groundPoint
    end
    return MapHelper:GetSafeLandingPoint(worldPos)
end

local function getMarkerSnapshot()
    local markers = {}
    for _,markerVo in pairs(_mapMarkersByUserId) do
        table.insert(markers,markerVo)
    end
    table.sort(markers,function(a,b)
        return a.userId < b.userId
    end)
    return markers
end

local function sendMarkerSnapshot(player:Player)
    GameHelper.MapMarkerSnapshotS2C:FireClient(player,getMarkerSnapshot())
end

local function upsertPlayerMarker(player:Player,position:Vector3)
    local markerVo = buildMarkerVo(player,position)
    _mapMarkersByUserId[player.UserId] = markerVo
    createMarkerModel(markerVo)
    GameHelper.MapMarkerUpsertS2C:FireAllClients(markerVo)
end

local function removePlayerMarker(userId:number)
    if not _mapMarkersByUserId[userId] then return end
    _mapMarkersByUserId[userId] = nil
    destroyMarkerModel(userId)
    GameHelper.MapMarkerRemoveS2C:FireAllClients(userId)
end

GameHelper.PlaceMapMarkerC2S.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player:Player,mapScale:Vector2)

    if not canUseMapMarkers(player) then return end

    local heat, level = getCampfireState()
    if heat <= 0 then return end
    if mapScale.X < 0 or mapScale.X > 1 or mapScale.Y < 0 or mapScale.Y > 1 then return end

    local position = resolveMarkerWorldPosition(mapScale)
    if not position then return end
    if not isMarkerPositionUnlocked(position,level) then return end

    upsertPlayerMarker(player,position)
end)

GameHelper.RemoveMapMarkerC2S.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player:Player)

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local GameHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("GameHelper"))
local MapHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("MapHelper"))
local ValueHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("ValueHelper"))

local CampfireValue = ValueHelper.ValueModel.CampfireValue

local MAP_MARKERS_FOLDER_NAME = "MapMarkers"
local MARKER_PREFAB_NAME = "MapMarker"
local MARKER_HEIGHT_OFFSET = Vector3.new(0, 1.25, 0)
local MARKER_AUTO_REMOVE_DISTANCE = 10

local markersByUserId:{[number]:{userId:number, nickname:string, position:Vector3}} = {}

local function getMarkerName(userId:number)
    return string.format("MapMarker_%d", userId)
end

local function getMarkersFolder()
    local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild(MAP_MARKERS_FOLDER_NAME)
    if folder and folder:IsA("Model") then
        folder.ModelStreamingMode = Enum.ModelStreamingMode.Persistent
        return folder
    end

    local model = Instance.new("Model")
    model.Name = MAP_MARKERS_FOLDER_NAME
    model.ModelStreamingMode = Enum.ModelStreamingMode.Persistent
    model.Parent = workspace
    return model
end

local function getMarkerPrefab()
    local prefabs = workspace:FindFirstChild("Prefabs")
    local mapFolder = prefabs and prefabs:FindFirstChild("Map")
    local prefab = mapFolder and mapFolder:FindFirstChild(MARKER_PREFAB_NAME)
    if prefab and prefab:IsA("Model") then
        return prefab
    end
end

local function createFallbackMarkerModel()
    local model = Instance.new("Model")
    model.Name = MARKER_PREFAB_NAME
    model.ModelStreamingMode = Enum.ModelStreamingMode.Persistent

    local root = Instance.new("Part")
    root.Name = "Root"
    root.Size = Vector3.new(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
    root.Anchored = true
    root.CanCollide = false
    root.CanQuery = false
    root.CanTouch = false
    root.Transparency = 1
    root.Parent = model

    local flag = Instance.new("Part")
    flag.Name = "Flag"
    flag.Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 2.2, 0.2)
    flag.Anchored = true
    flag.CanCollide = false
    flag.CanQuery = false
    flag.CanTouch = false
    flag.Color = Color3.fromRGB(227, 190, 88)
    flag.Material = Enum.Material.Wood
    flag.Position = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
    flag.Parent = model

    local sign = Instance.new("Part")
    sign.Name = "Point"
    sign.Size = Vector3.new(1.4, 1, 0.2)
    sign.Anchored = true
    sign.CanCollide = false
    sign.CanQuery = false
    sign.CanTouch = false
    sign.Color = Color3.fromRGB(208, 76, 61)
    sign.Material = Enum.Material.WoodPlanks
    sign.Position = Vector3.new(0.8, 1.6, 0)
    sign.Parent = model

    local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
    billboard.Name = "BillboardGui"
    billboard.Enabled = false
    billboard.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(180, 56)
    billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2.7, 0)
    billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
    billboard.Parent = root

    local t_name = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    t_name.Name = "t_name"
    t_name.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    t_name.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.55)
    t_name.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 239, 189)
    t_name.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.3
    t_name.TextScaled = true
    t_name.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
    t_name.Parent = billboard

    local t_distance = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    t_distance.Name = "t_distance"
    t_distance.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    t_distance.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
    t_distance.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1)
    t_distance.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.45)
    t_distance.Text = ""
    t_distance.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 239, 189)
    t_distance.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.3
    t_distance.TextScaled = true
    t_distance.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
    t_distance.Parent = billboard

    model.PrimaryPart = root
    return model
end

local function getMarkerModelTemplate()
    return getMarkerPrefab() or createFallbackMarkerModel()
end

local function destroyMarkerModel(userId:number)
    local folder = getMarkersFolder()
    local markerModel = folder:FindFirstChild(getMarkerName(userId))
    if markerModel then
        markerModel:Destroy()
    end
end

local function isPlayerAlive(player:Player)
    local character = player.Character
    if not character then return false end
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
    return humanoid ~= nil and humanoid.Health > 0
end

local function getCampfireState()
    local campfire = MapHelper:GetCampfire()
    if not campfire then return end

    local v_heat:NumberValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(campfire, CampfireValue.heat)
    if not v_heat then
        v_heat = ValueHelper:WaitValue(campfire, CampfireValue.heat)
    end

    local v_level:NumberValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(campfire, CampfireValue.level)
    if not v_level then
        v_level = ValueHelper:WaitValue(campfire, CampfireValue.level)
    end

    return campfire, v_heat, v_level
end

local function isMarkerPositionUnlocked(position:Vector3, campfireLevel:number)
    local grid1X, grid1Z = MapHelper:Pos2Grid1(position)
    if not MapHelper:IsInMapGrid1(grid1X, grid1Z) then
        return false
    end
    return MapHelper:GetZoneLevelByGrid1(grid1X, grid1Z) <= campfireLevel
end

local function resolveMarkerWorldPosition(scaleX:number, scaleZ:number)
    local worldPos = MapHelper:MapScaleToWorldPos(scaleX, scaleZ)
    local groundPoint = MapHelper:GetGroundPoint(worldPos)
    if groundPoint then
        return groundPoint
    end

    local safePoint = MapHelper:GetSafeLandingPoint(worldPos)
    if safePoint then
        return safePoint
    end
end

local function buildMarkerVo(player:Player, position:Vector3)
    return {
        userId = player.UserId,
        nickname = player.DisplayName or player.Name,
        position = position,
    }
end

local function isPlayerNearMarker(player:Player, markerVo:{userId:number, nickname:string, position:Vector3})
    local character = player.Character
    if not character then return false end

    local humanoidRootPart:BasePart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not humanoidRootPart then return false end

    return (humanoidRootPart.Position - markerVo.position).Magnitude <= MARKER_AUTO_REMOVE_DISTANCE
end

local function applyNickname(model:Model, nickname:string)
    for _, descendant in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
        if descendant:IsA("TextLabel") and descendant.Name == "t_name" then
            descendant.Text = nickname
        end
    end
end

local function ensurePrimaryPart(model:Model)
    if model.PrimaryPart then
        return model.PrimaryPart
    end

    local primaryPart = model:FindFirstChild("Root")
    if primaryPart and primaryPart:IsA("BasePart") then
        model.PrimaryPart = primaryPart
        return primaryPart
    end

    primaryPart = model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
    if primaryPart then
        model.PrimaryPart = primaryPart
        return primaryPart
    end

    local root = Instance.new("Part")
    root.Name = "Root"
    root.Size = Vector3.new(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
    root.Anchored = true
    root.CanCollide = false
    root.CanQuery = false
    root.CanTouch = false
    root.Transparency = 1
    root.Parent = model
    model.PrimaryPart = root
    return root
end

local function createMarkerModel(markerVo:{userId:number, nickname:string, position:Vector3})
    destroyMarkerModel(markerVo.userId)

    local markerModel = getMarkerModelTemplate():Clone()
    markerModel.Name = getMarkerName(markerVo.userId)
    markerModel.ModelStreamingMode = Enum.ModelStreamingMode.Persistent

    local primaryPart = ensurePrimaryPart(markerModel)
    primaryPart.Anchored = true
    primaryPart.CanCollide = false
    primaryPart.CanQuery = false
    primaryPart.CanTouch = false

    applyNickname(markerModel, markerVo.nickname)

    markerModel:PivotTo(CFrame.new(markerVo.position + MARKER_HEIGHT_OFFSET))
    markerModel.Parent = getMarkersFolder()
end

local function getMarkerSnapshot()
    local snapshot = {}
    for _, markerVo in pairs(markersByUserId) do
        table.insert(snapshot, markerVo)
    end
    table.sort(snapshot, function(a, b)
        return a.userId < b.userId
    end)
    return snapshot
end

local function sendMarkerSnapshot(player:Player)
    GameHelper.MapMarkerSnapshotS2C:FireClient(player, getMarkerSnapshot())
end

local function upsertPlayerMarker(player:Player, position:Vector3)
    local markerVo = buildMarkerVo(player, position)
    markersByUserId[player.UserId] = markerVo
    createMarkerModel(markerVo)
    GameHelper.MapMarkerUpsertS2C:FireAllClients(markerVo)
end

local function removePlayerMarker(player:Player, shouldBroadcast:boolean?)
    if not markersByUserId[player.UserId] then return end
    markersByUserId[player.UserId] = nil
    destroyMarkerModel(player.UserId)
    if shouldBroadcast ~= false then
        GameHelper.MapMarkerRemoveS2C:FireAllClients(player.UserId)
    end
end

GameHelper.PlaceMapMarkerC2S.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player:Player, mapScale:Vector2)
    if typeof(mapScale) ~= "Vector2" then return end
    if not isPlayerAlive(player) then return end

    local _, v_heat, v_level = getCampfireState()
    if not v_heat or not v_level then return end
    if v_heat.Value <= 0 then return end

    local scaleX = mapScale.X
    local scaleZ = mapScale.Y
    if scaleX < 0 or scaleX > 1 or scaleZ < 0 or scaleZ > 1 then
        return
    end

    local markerPosition = resolveMarkerWorldPosition(scaleX, scaleZ)
    if not markerPosition then return end
    if not isMarkerPositionUnlocked(markerPosition, v_level.Value) then return end

    upsertPlayerMarker(player, markerPosition)
end)

GameHelper.RemoveMapMarkerC2S.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player:Player)
    removePlayerMarker(player)
end)

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
    task.spawn(function()
        local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 15)
        if not playerGui then return end
        task.wait(1)
        sendMarkerSnapshot(player)
    end)
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
    removePlayerMarker(player)
end)

local nextMarkerCheckTime = 0
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if workspace.DistributedGameTime < nextMarkerCheckTime then return end
    nextMarkerCheckTime = workspace.DistributedGameTime + 0.5

    for userId, markerVo in pairs(markersByUserId) do
        local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(userId)
        if player and isPlayerAlive(player) and isPlayerNearMarker(player, markerVo) then
            removePlayerMarker(player)
        end
    end
end)

for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    task.spawn(function()
        local playerGui = player:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui") or player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 15)
        if not playerGui then return end
        task.wait(1)
        sendMarkerSnapshot(player)
    end)
end

function onTagAdded(tree:Model,connections:{RBXScriptConnection})
    table.insert(connections,tree:GetAttributeChangedSignal("hp"):Connect(function()
        local hp = tree:GetAttribute("hp")
        if hp <= 0 then -- 树木死亡
            -- 播放音效
            AudioHelper:PlayEffect("树倒下",tree.PrimaryPart)

            tree:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.Tree)
            tree:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.BigTree)

            for _,child in ipairs(tree:GetDescendants()) do
                if child == tree.PrimaryPart then continue end
                if child:IsA("BasePart") then
                    local basePart:BasePart = child
                    basePart.Anchored = false
                    basePart.CanCollide = true
                    basePart.CollisionGroup = GameEnum.CollisionGroup.OnlyGround
                    local r = math.random(20,40)

function onTagAdded(item:Model,connections:{RBXScriptConnection})
    if item:IsDescendantOf(workspace:FindFirstChild("Prefabs")) then return end

    -- 齿轮资源点的模型使用 ResourceItemId 标记；替换完成后的克隆已初始化，
    -- 不应再次被 NatureResItemService 当成原始资源处理。
    local id = item:GetAttribute("id")
    if typeof(id) ~= "number" then
        id = item:GetAttribute("ResourceItemId")
    end
    if typeof(id) ~= "number" then
        id = tonumber(item.Name)
    end
    if not id then
        warn("[NatureResItemService] Missing resource id:", item:GetFullName())
        return
    end
    if id == 248 and item:HasTag("DragItemValue_InitComplete") then
        return
    end

    if ResourcesItemHelper:FindPrefab(id) then
        -- 替换掉
        local cframe = item:GetPivot()
        local newItem = ResourcesItemHelper:CreateItem(id,cframe)
        if newItem then
            -- 248 的新对象已经完成初始化，不再保留原始资源标签，避免二次替换。
            if id == 248 then
                newItem:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.NatureResItem)
            end
            for _, attributeName in ipairs({"GearSourceId", "GearSourceZone", "GearSourceState", "GearSourceConsumed"}) do
                local attributeValue = item:GetAttribute(attributeName)
                if attributeValue ~= nil then
                    newItem:SetAttribute(attributeName, attributeValue)
                end
            end
        end
        if item.PrimaryPart and newItem and newItem.PrimaryPart then
            newItem.PrimaryPart.Anchored = item.PrimaryPart.Anchored
        end
        item:Destroy()
    else
        -- 直接用
        ResourcesItemHelper:InitItem(id,item)
    end
end
